data.name: Qurb
data.gender_notes: Qurb is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'q-r-b', which means 'nearness' or 'closeness'. This name is often used to describe the close relationship between Allah and His creation, or the close bond between family members or friends. The name Qurb carries the meaning “Nearness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Qurb usually hope their child will grow to embody nearness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual journey towards Allah and the closeness one can achieve with Him through prayer, meditation, and good deeds.
data.etymology: Qurb belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Nearness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qurb total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the name Qurb can be a symbol of closeness in various aspects of life. It can represent the closeness of Allah and His Prophet, the Prophet's companions, or even the closeness between family members or friends. It can also be a reminder of the importance of maintaining strong relationships and working towards bringing people closer to Allah.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Qurb carries significant meaning. It represents the goal of all believers to draw closer to Allah and strengthen their bond with Him. It serves as a reminder that the ultimate reward awaits those who strive for nearness to Allah, and that through acts of obedience, good deeds, and prayer, one can come closer to their Creator. The name can also inspire a sense of peace, comfort, and a deeper understanding of the love and mercy that Allah has for His creatures. Overall, the name Qurb is a powerful reminder of the importance of both earthly relationships and the relationship between the believer and their Creator.
